nodes.description: Owner address state variable controlling privileged access to the contract.
Constructor that sets owner to msg.sender on deployment.
External function gated by require(msg.sender == owner) that pulls tokens via transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used both for owner assignment and for the access-control require.
External call to _token.transferFrom(_sender,_receiver,_amount) which can invoke arbitrary token code.
Caller-supplied IERC20Token instance whose transferFrom is invoked.
Caller-supplied source address for the token transfer.
Caller-supplied destination address for the token transfer.
Caller-supplied token amount forwarded to transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into the owner state variable during construction, anchoring the privileged role to the deployer.
The owner state variable is read in require(msg.sender == owner), deciding whether transferUniswapV3LessGas proceeds.
msg.sender participates in the access-control require gate that protects transferUniswapV3LessGas.
The function performs an external call to transferFrom, and the token callee can reenter before returning.
The _token parameter selects the external contract whose transferFrom is executed.
The _sender parameter is passed as the from-address of the external transferFrom call.
The _receiver parameter is passed as the to-address of the external transferFrom call.
The _amount parameter is passed as the value of the external transferFrom call.

normalization_plan.reason: The _token parameter only exists to select the target of the unsafe external call, so it can be folded into that unsafe_operation node.
The _sender parameter is consumed solely as an argument of the external transferFrom call and can be merged into it.
The _receiver parameter is used only as the destination argument of the unsafe external call and can be merged into it.
The _amount parameter is a pure argument of the external transferFrom call and can be merged into it.
